problem_text:
A logistics coordinator needs to assign shipments to identical cargo planes. Shipments:
* Component Alpha: size 48 cubic meters
* Component Beta: size 67 cubic meters
* Component Gamma: size 60 cubic meters
* Component Delta: size 43 cubic meters
* Component Epsilon: size 31 cubic meters
* Component Zeta: size 59 cubic meters
* Component Eta: size 69 cubic meters
* Component Theta: size 68 cubic meters
* Component Iota: size 41 cubic meters
* Component Kappa: size 69 cubic meters
* Component Lambda: size 58 cubic meters
* Component Mu: size 50 cubic meters
* Component Nu: size 67 cubic meters
* Component Xi: size 50 cubic meters
* Component Omicron: size 57 cubic meters
* Component Pi: size 66 cubic meters
* Component Rho: size 70 cubic meters
* Component Sigma: size 39 cubic meters
* Component Tau: size 62 cubic meters
* Component Upsilon: size 57 cubic meters
* Component Phi: size 55 cubic meters
* Component Chi: size 45 cubic meters
* Component Psi: size 53 cubic meters
* Component Omega: size 54 cubic meters
* Article A: size 48 cubic meters
* Article B: size 45 cubic meters

Each cargo plane can carry up to 100 cubic meters of freight. Assign all shipments using the fewest planes. Every shipment must be loaded onto exactly one plane, and the total volume in any plane cannot exceed its capacity.
